'''Tortali IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="XWvTF">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref> located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Battle of Tortali IV|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
